description: Compare Menagerie mission, rank, unlock, bonus, and resource states with matching offline v1.23 outputs for the retained account save

extractions.label: account_progression
extractions.description: Saved Lumi, Shells, and rank, threshold, calculated hourly Lumi, and available missions/unlocks/bonuses

extractions.label: mission_availability_inputs
extractions.description: Native baseline, bonus, Research, Jade Emporium, Bank bundle, and mission catalog availability contributors

extractions.label: mission_states
extractions.expression: Array.from({ length: 33 }, (_, i) => [i, idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("Menagerie")[1][i], idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "Cost", 0, i), idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "CanClaim", 0, i)])
extractions.description: Saved claims, current threshold, and readiness for every Menagerie mission

extractions.label: unlock_states
extractions.expression: Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => [i, idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "UnlockOwned", i, 0), idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "Cost", 1, i), idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "CanClaim", 1, i)])
extractions.description: Ownership, next Lumi cost, and affordability for every Menagerie unlock

extractions.label: bonus_states
extractions.expression: Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => [i, idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("Menagerie")[3][i], idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "BoostQTY", i, 0), idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "Cost", 2, i), idleon.callFunction("MenagerieStuff", "CanClaim", 2, i)])
extractions.description: Current levels and effects, next costs, and affordability for all repeatable Menagerie bonuses

extractions.label: usable_resources
extractions.description: Currently usable Black Stars, Organic Labels, and remaining upgrade doubler resources

extractions.label: bonus_level_factors
extractions.description: Native effect-per-level values used to calculate each bonus's current and next effect
